def transform(grid):
    rs=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1]
    cs=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid})==1]
    rb=[-1]+rs+[len(grid)]; cb=[-1]+cs+[len(grid[0])]
    out=[]
    bg=max((v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (4,)),key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    mark=min((v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (4,bg)),key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        a,b=rb[ri]+1,rb[ri+1]
        if a==b: continue
        line=[]
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            c,d=cb[ci]+1,cb[ci+1]
            if c==d: continue
            line.append(1 if sum(v==mark for row in grid[a:b] for v in row[c:d])>=2 else bg)
        out.append(line)
    return out
